statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let lam := fun x : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ block x, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n^2+1); let pp := fun x : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => ¬ Nat.Prime (n^2+1)), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n^2+1); let primeMass := fun x : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => Nat.Prime (n^2+1)), Real.log ((n^2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ); ∀ x : ℕ, lam x = primeMass x + pp x

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0068 · 把二次 Mangoldt 质量精确分成素数与真幂
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0068 · Split quadratic Mangoldt mass into prime and proper-power contributions

brief.zh: 按 n²+1 的素性分割区间，素数上的 Mangoldt 权等于 log。
brief.en: Partition the interval by primality of the quadratic value and evaluate the prime weights.
